method: candidate lines proposed by corridor detection; identity decided from printed address runs
why_not_one_block_off: PRINTED NAME: the corridor is lettered AVENUE T down the roadway on BOTH sheets, with the roadway width 70' printed inside it on both - sheet 90 at native x~1170 (70' at ~1177), sheet 99's RIGHT-HAND PANEL at native x~1816 (70' at ~1801). AVENUE-FACE RUNS: on 90 its west face carries 3902-3928 and its east face 3901-3931, i.e. the 39th-40th segment of Ave T, and 4002-4022 / 4001-4021 for 40th-41st; on 99's right panel its east face carries 3805-3827, the 38th-39th segment, and 3701-3727 for 37th-38th. CROSS-STREET RUNS (the hundred-block test): on sheet 90 along 39th St, the seam street, the run west of the line ends 2619 2621 2623 and the run east of it begins 2701 2703 2705 2707 2709 2711 - a 2600|2700 transition; the same break repeats on 40th and 41st St. On sheet 99's right panel along 39th St the run east of the line begins 2702 2704 2706 2708 2710 2712 and along 38th St 2701 2703 2705 2707 2709 2711; the 2600 block west of it is not on that panel. On 99's right panel the 2700 block is closed on the east by Ave T 1/2 at 2771.7 (2713-2723 west of it, 2801-2811 and 3802-3828 east of it), which fixes Ave T as the WEST edge of the 2700 block - exactly what it is on sheet 90. ONE BLOCK WEST is AVENUE S 1/2 - on 90 at native 174.0, where the runs go 2500|2600; it is not on 99's right panel. ONE BLOCK EAST is AVENUE T 1/2 - on 99's right panel at 2771.7, where the runs go 2700|2800 - and on SHEET 90 IT IS NOT DRAFTED AT ALL: blocks NE/SE 184 (39th-40th) and NE/SE 183 (41st-42nd) are undivided beach ground and there is no vertical line of any kind between Ave T's east face (1270.7) and Ave U's west face (3058.0); only the address run changes (...2725 2727 2729 | 2801 2803 2805) and the sheet-edge tag 'Av. T 1/2' marks where it leaves the plate. Ave T 1/2 is therefore unusable as a control here, and Ave T is the only shared corridor printed as a corridor on both plates. NOTE ON EQUAL-NATIVE-X (rejected): the proposed candidates (90: 768 / 1764 / 2761; 99: 766 / 1772 / 2778) pair off almost exactly by native x and are that artefact; on 90 they fall in undivided block interiors, not corridors.
measurement_note: Native x = raster x of work/sheets/1912w/u<unit>.jpg (3327x3898), origin top-left. Measured in the block row ADJACENT to the 39th St seam: sheet 90 the 39th-40th row (evaluated y=885), sheet 99 the 38th-39th row (evaluated y=3160). SHEET 90 is direct: both faces of Ave T are printed, 1064.1 / 1270.7, width 206.6, centre 1167.4. SHEET 99 IS A COMPOSITE OF TWO BEACH-STRIP PANELS separated by a heavy rule down native x 1725-1745, each with its own north arrow and its own Gulf of Mexico shoreline. The LEFT panel covers 33rd-36th St and prints its own AVENUE T at native ~1255 (Ave S 1/2 at ~215); the RIGHT panel covers 36th-39th St and prints AVENUE T at ~1816 (Ave T 1/2 at 2771.7). ONLY THE RIGHT PANEL REACHES 39th ST, the seam with sheet 90 - its bottom margin carries the '90' tag - so the right panel's Ave T is the line reported here; taking the left panel's Ave T instead would be a ~525 px error, and the two panels cannot both be registered by one affine. On the right panel the WEST face of the Ave T roadway would fall at ~1676, west of the panel rule, so it is not drawn; the centre is fixed from the printed EAST face, 1883.0, minus half the panel's own 70-ft roadway (Ave T 1/2 measures 2668.3 / 2875.0 = 206.7 wide) -> 1779.7. That half-width matches sheet 90's own Ave T width (206.6) to 0.1 px, and the resulting T -> T 1/2 spacing on 99 (992.0) matches the S 1/2 -> T spacing on 90 (993.4). No mid-block alley is drafted in either seam-row block, so no alley cross-check was available. FLAG for the solver: sheet 99's two panels are internally out of register, so any other control taken on its LEFT panel will disagree with this one by ~525 px.
